links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated plain-language summaries of plastic surgery research versus original articles
links.effect: Grok reached 7th-9th grade level (FRE M=63.06, FKGL M=7.69) and significantly outperformed others; ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek stayed at 10th-12th grade, not significantly different from originals (P>0.05).
links.quote: ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek showed moderate improvements but did not achieve statistically significant differences from the original articles (P > 0.05), with average grade levels between the 10th and 12th grades.

links.outcome: Whether generative AI output matched lower health literacy targets while preserving accuracy
links.effect: Only Grok met sixth- to eighth-grade health literacy benchmarks with accuracy preserved; other three models fell short with 10th-12th grade outputs.
links.quote: Grok demonstrated superior readability while preserving accuracy, making it the only LLM to meet health literacy benchmarks.

screen.reason: Evaluates four LLMs on their ability to simplify plastic surgery research articles to targeted patient reading levels, with physician review for accuracy, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational safeguard/deployment practice.
